rows.law: FOLD-BY-SCRIPT EXTENDED (A5): the counting script writes the numbers, seats write prose around them
rows.claim: Any fold number a seat brings from a summary instead of a script recount must be tagged carried; script-written counts are the only untagged numbers in the fold.
rows.quote: The seat writes prose around script-written numbers only; any number taken from a summary instead of recomputed is tagged `carried` (A5).
rows.steal: In GALA lanes, file every count from a saved raw tool output file and cite it; any count not recountable from a saved file gets tagged carried instead of asserted.
rows.falsifier: A fold or lane summary asserting a number with no script recount behind it, or a rerun of the counting script disagreeing with the archived counts (rerun today agreed on all sections).

rows.law: TWO-TIER VERIFICATION (A3+A4): mechanical selection, independent verifier, crashed confirmers in their own bucket
rows.claim: Deep verification goes to fold-load-bearing rows selected mechanically by the script plus every tier-1 supports-no row, on a different model family; a crashed confirmation is never merged with a substantive unconfirmation.
rows.quote: crashed confirmers count in their own bucket, never merged with substantive unconfirmations (A3+A4).
rows.steal: In GALA checks, record a crashed verifier as its own verdict bucket with its own count, never folded into the unconfirmed negative count.
rows.falsifier: A fold whose verifier table merges crashed confirmers into the unconfirmed bucket; the archived and rerun verifier tables keep buckets separate (checks/entries/rows/supports, no crashed bucket present in this run).

rows.law: REFIRE-ONCE-THEN-TOMBSTONE (A2): a dead lane is a result; a twice-dead lane is a filed tombstone
rows.claim: A crashed or killed lane is re-fired exactly once with the kill reason named in the prompt; after a second death the lane is tombstoned with status tombstoned, empty receipts, error verbatim, and subtracted from owed.
rows.quote: A dead lane is a valid lane file of exactly one negative-result row; a twice-dead lane is a tombstone
rows.steal: Give any dead GALA sub-lane one bounded idempotent refill naming the kill reason, then file a tombstone receipt instead of silently dropping the target.
rows.falsifier: A lane archive showing the same target id re-fired more than once, or a tombstone carrying non-empty receipts or a missing verbatim error.

rows.law: ABSOLUTE-PATHS / PER-RUN ARCHIVES (A1 repair): the recount runs against the estate copy, never a workspace mirror
rows.claim: v2 broke Law 4 for its own lane archive; A1 fixed it so the archive of record is the estate absolute path and the fold script takes only a bare run slug with pathlib-fixed constants, no free-form path input at all.
rows.quote: the fold's scripted recount runs against the estate copy, never a workspace mirror.
rows.steal: Point GALA checks at estate-path artifacts as the source of record and reject tool CLIs that accept arbitrary workspace paths where an estate slug suffices.
rows.falsifier: A fold tool that reads a workspace mirror or accepts arbitrary path input; tools/mickey17_v2_fold.py instead validates --run against [A-Za-z0-9-]+ and rejects traversal, and its module docstring states pathlib-only fixed constants, no os.path.join chains, no open().

rows.law: SCOREBOARD BY ESTATE_STATUS: confirms-ours is the moat, owed is the build queue, new is the gate gap, we-have-better is the discount ledger
rows.claim: The v2 master fold (50 lanes, 246 rows) put confirms-ours first at 96 rows, owed 61, we-have-better 48, new 41; the v2.1 rerun recount of the 40-lane archive matches its archived scoreboard exactly (218 rows: new 131, confirms-ours 59, owed 18, we-have-better 10), so owed items carry vendor-measured defaults and the build queue has never been cheaper to execute.
rows.quote: 246 rows across 50 lanes (49 ok, 1 dead), all rows carrying a valid estate_status.
rows.steal: Bucket every GALA row by estate_status so confirms-ours banks validation for free, owed converts one-to-one into build specs, and we-have-better files as discount annotations never canon numbers.
rows.falsifier: A hand-written scoreboard disagreeing with a script recount of the same lane archive, or a fold missing any of the four estate_status buckets; both the archived and rerun recounts satisfy the four-bucket partition.

checks.command: grep -F -c '<each of 5 quotes>' against spec and master (counts 1,1,1,1,1) + estate greps mickey17 and two-tier over corpus/steal and memory/corpus
